coverage.evidence: Eight charity keys: charity.name, charity.link, charity.raised, charity.target, charity.percent, charity.bar (CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:18-43) and charity.donations.count, charity.donations.latest (CharityDonationHelpers.cs:18-30). None takes an argument: a row prints only when call.Args.Count == 0 (LiveCharityRows.cs:33,50). CharityHelpersTests.cs:91 asserts 8 entries.

Samples match the page examples (CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:18-43; CharityHelpersTests.cs:24-31). Money keeps Twitch decimal places with the culture's grouping, symbol first, unknown code after the number (LiveText.cs:60-67). Percent is rounded away from zero and not clamped (LiveText.cs:36-37; MusicText.cs:47-49). Bar is 10 blocks, rounded, clamped to 0..100, then the percent (LiveText.cs:40-50; MeterBars.cs:17-30). Target 0 returns null (LiveText.cs:37,41). An empty link returns null (CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:22). Culture is the channel language, en-US when unset (LiveEventRow.cs:28; NumberCulture.cs:22-35).

Live-event rows use TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (LiveEventRow.cs:45). Standard is every context except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). That means Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperContext.cs:21-63).

LiveCharityData reads the active campaign from Twitch Helix charity/campaigns once per render (LiveCharityData.cs:43-48,57-63; TwitchCharityApi.cs:46-54). A failed or empty response becomes null (TwitchHelixTransport.cs:107-110). It does not read supporter events.

One page of donations, first=100 (TwitchPage.cs:15; TwitchCharityApi.cs:75). Twitch returns no total, so Total is 0 (TwitchHelixTransport.cs:139) and the count is the item count, at most 100 (CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21). An empty list gives 0, and latest returns null for an empty list (CharityDonationHelpers.cs:27-29).

When the evaluator returns null, the token prints as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19,62,118). Charity rows return null on a missing campaign, a failed call, a missing scope or any argument (LiveCharityRows.cs:33-35,50-52; TwitchCharityApi.cs:38-40,64-66; LiveCharityData.cs:62,71).

reader_answers.evidence: The eight helper names and the no-argument rule match CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:18-43, CharityDonationHelpers.cs:18-30 and LiveCharityRows.cs:33,50.

The scope pre-check needs channel:read:charity (TwitchCharityApi.cs:32-40; TwitchScopes.cs:44). The base login does not request it (AuthService.cs:80-89). An active campaign is required (TwitchHelixTransport.cs:107-110).

Values or braces follow TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19. The three causes map to the scope failure (TwitchCharityApi.cs:38-40), no campaign (TwitchHelixTransport.cs:107-110) and a failed call (LiveCharityData.cs:62). The count cap of 100 matches TwitchCharityApi.cs:75 and CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21.

The helper choice and the empty-donation fallback match CharityDonationHelpers.cs:27-29. But 'With no active campaign, every charity helper prints as typed' is wrong for {charity.donations.count}. Twitch's Get Charity Campaign Donations returns an empty data list when no campaign is running. TwitchHelixTransport.cs:135-140 turns that into a successful empty page, so CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21 prints 0. The page's line 89 wording led the reader to over-generalize.

findings: The page says 'Until the permission is granted, every charity helper prints as typed' (charity.mdx:18) but never says where to grant it, and that omission is material: the only grant control is 'Grant the missing permissions' in the Event feed section of the setup page (dashboard/src/views/site/setup/components/EventFeedHealth.vue:68-77, views/site/setup/SetupView.vue:102), and the Needs attention item shows no Open button for this gap because its route 'integrations' is not in attentionPages (dashboard/src/api/actionRequiredText.ts:44-55,130-137; TwitchGrantGapSource.cs:154), so a reader who sees braces cannot fix the cause from this page.

The page says 'With no campaign running, every helper in the reply prints as typed' (charity.mdx:89) and lists 'No campaign is running' as a cause of braces (charity.mdx:40), but it leaves out that {charity.donations.count} shows 0 in that state: Twitch returns an empty donation list when no campaign runs, TwitchHelixTransport.cs:135-140 treats that as a successful page, and CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21 prints 0, so a reader can mistake 'no campaign' for 'no donations yet' (reader answer 4 made this mistake).
